remarks: **Best and final offers provided to seller agent by Wed (6/3/26) at 5pm. Seller will have a decision by Noon on Thursday.**  Move right into this beautifully updated Darien home offering an exceptional blend of modern luxury, open-concept living, and commuter convenience. Designed for both effortless entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the sun-filled interior features soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and a stunning chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, smart appliances, and seamless flow into the family room and oversized deck.  Step outside to a private, fenced backyard backing directly to Woodway Country Club-creating a serene, scenic setting just minutes from downtown Darien and New Canaan, Talmadge Hill train station, and the Merritt Parkway.  A versatile first-floor bedroom suite with full bath and its own private deck is ideal for guests, in-laws, or an au pair suite. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite offers dual walk-in closets and a spacious bath, along with four additional bedrooms (total of 5 bedrooms), a full bath, and a convenient second-floor laundry room. An oversized attached garage and large basement playroom make this a must see!  Thoughtfully maintained with significant capital improvements, including updated mechanicals and a newer roof, this turnkey home presents a rare opportunity in a prime Darien location.
